content: CONFIRMED — Queue a prompt, promote it to `STEER`, then call `continueWithSteer` or `beginNextTurn` with a transition that throws. `MemoryHostStore` catches the failure and `rollbackUninjectedSteer` mutates state by incrementing the queue/event/snapshot revisions and appending `queue.steer_rolled_back`. `PersistentHostStore` then persists those changes while rethrowing, so a restart exposes timeline/replay side effects from a failed command. `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-core\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\PersistentHostStore.java:237`
